milestones.title: Toolchain and skeleton
milestones.gate: `ctest` runs a CPU and a CUDA hello-kernel test on both GPUs; `kicad-cli version` works from the harness
milestones.deliverables: CMake presets (`debug`, `release`, `asan`, `cpu-only`), CUDA build with a GCC host compiler that `nvcc 12.4` accepts, Catch2, clang-format/clang-tidy config (or GCC equivalents), `scripts/bootstrap.sh`, `kicad-cli` available (Docker image or native), fixture download script

tasks.text: Ubuntu setup script (packages, Docker, KiCad 10 kicad-cli wrapper)
CMake project + presets (debug, release, cpu-only, asan, tsan)
CUDA build: nvcc 12.4 with g++-13 host, sm_60 + sm_70; system GCC 15 for C++
Core library: units, deterministic Philox/SplitMix RNG
GPU service: device discovery by UUID, free-memory admission control
First kernel with CPU reference; bit-identical on V100 and P100
Catch2 tests wired into ctest with JUnit results
scripts/bootstrap.sh: configure, build and test all presets
Benchmark environment check (kicad-cli from the harness)
Fixture download script (Freerouting, DAC2020, KiCad demos, PCBench)
Gate: CPU + CUDA tests pass on both GPUs; kicad-cli works from harness

milestones.title: KiCad I/O and board model
milestones.gate: Byte-identical round-trip of every fixture board (parse → write); netlist equals `kicad-cli sch export netlist` on all fixture projects
milestones.deliverables: s-expression lexer/parser/writer; `.kicad_pcb`, `.kicad_pro`, `.kicad_dru`, `.kicad_sch` (netlist), `.kicad_mod`; board model with layers, stackup, footprints, pads, tracks, vias, zones, nets, net classes; DSN reader

tasks.text: Lossless s-expression parser/writer with span edits
Board reader: layers, nets (KiCad 9 and 10 syntax), footprints, pads, tracks, arcs, vias, zones, graphics
Reader verified against pcbnew ground truth on demo boards
Byte-identical round trip of fixture boards
Design rules: .kicad_pro net classes, patterns, assignments, board minimums
Custom rules: .kicad_dru parsed into rules and constraints
Board editor: add/remove tracks and vias, move/rotate footprints
Edited boards load in pcbnew with the expected geometry
Netlist import via kicad-cli (kicadsexpr) and cross-check against board pad nets
tracemaker inspect: board summary and JSON dump
Gate: round trip on all fixtures; reader matches KiCad

milestones.title: Rules and DRC parity
milestones.gate: Same violation multiset as `kicad-cli pcb drc` on all unrouted and routed fixture boards (documented, tested exceptions only)
milestones.deliverables: Rule compiler (net classes, board constraints, custom rules subset), spatial indices, own DRC with KiCad violation names

tasks.text: Exact integer geometry kernel (rounded-core shapes, int128 predicates, fine arc flattening)
Copper item model: pads (all shapes, drill offsets), tracks, arcs, vias, zone fills, copper graphics with nets
Rule engine: net classes, local overrides, diff pairs, board minimums, legacy rules, custom-rule conditions
Checks: clearance, shorts, crossings, widths, vias, annular, holes, edge, keepouts
Anchor/overlap connectivity, unconnected items, dangling tracks/vias
DRC parity harness vs kicad-cli + fuzzer
Performance on very large boards (vme-wren, jetson)

milestones.title: Event bus, server, viewer v1
milestones.gate: Viewer renders the largest fixture board at ≥ 60 fps; replay of a recorded log reproduces the final board
milestones.deliverables: Event types, ring buffers, WebSocket server, FlatBuffers schema, replay log; WebGL2 viewer (WebGPU backend optional): layers, pan/zoom, pads/tracks/vias/zones, ratsnest, dark theme

milestones.title: First router (lattice A*)
milestones.gate: Routes the simple fixture set with 0 added KiCad DRC errors; harness produces the comparison table
milestones.deliverables: Rerun debug logging of searches (optional), transactions, scoring, union-find, bit-planes, A* + radix heap, insertion with exact validation, basic pull-tight; sequential routing in net order; `tracemaker route` CLI; bench harness v1 with KiCad-DRC judge and Freerouting runner

tasks.text: bench harness v1 with KiCad-DRC judge and Freerouting runner

milestones.title: Failure memory T0–T2 + escalation R0–R3 + repair
milestones.gate: Completion ≥ Freerouting on the Freerouting test set; ablation shows each learning mechanism helps or is removed
milestones.deliverables: Failure records, Zobrist signatures, nogood store, history + targeted penalties, conflict graph, activity ordering, bandit; negotiated rip-up; repair windows; aggressor/victim repair

milestones.title: Global routing + GPU
milestones.gate: CPU and GPU results identical on every fixture; time-to-route reduced on dense boards with no quality loss
milestones.deliverables: Port/adapt GAMER sweep and GGR pattern kernels from Xplace `gpugr` (BSD-3); tile graph, Steiner decomposition, CPU NCR, corridors; GPU pattern routing, GPU sweep maze routing, GPU cost-to-go fields, GPU DRC broad-phase
